verdict.rationale: Bun's homepage publishes measured install-time numbers (bun v1.4 at 0.21s vs npm v12.0.2 at 4.45s) to back its headline '25x' / 'up to 30x faster' claims. A community comment separately reports 10-20x faster installs on Windows with isolated installs. missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark suite, independent hands-on corroboration of the headline numbers, and a single consistent multiplier (25x vs 30x claims differ).
